keyLimits.en: Basic scheduling, timesheets, time clocking, labor law compliance, shift swapping
Adds auto-scheduling, demand forecasting, labor optimization and wage budgets
Adds custom access levels, SSO, 24/7 live chat and a sandbox environment

cautions.en: A minimum monthly spend of $30 applies per account regardless of how few users are on it, and every admin/manager role is billed as a user.
Monthly billing charges for a full month even when a user is added partway through the month, and annual plans allow no mid-term downgrades or refunds.

capabilities.en: Staff scheduling with auto-scheduling and demand forecasting on the Core plan and above.
Time clocking and timesheets with built-in labor law compliance checks.
AI features ("Deputy AI") included across all plans.

limitations.en: No free plan; only a 30-day trial.
Auto-scheduling and demand forecasting are not available on the entry Lite plan.

reason.en: Time tracking and scheduling alternative for hourly and shift-based teams.
Alternative time tracking tool that also covers basic scheduling needs.
